notes: TelOne (state-owned telco) opened its first Matabeleland data centre at its Main Exchange in Bulawayo (Cnr Main Street & Leopold Takawira Street) in April 2022; Tier 3 designed facility with 120 racks and 400 kVA (~0.4 MW) total power, part of a US$4m+ investment since 2016.
